verdict.rationale: Granola's Mintlify-hosted API reference includes an interactive "Try it" playground. It sends live requests to https://public-api.granola.ai and is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, so the core story is documented. Running examples requires an API key that only Business or Enterprise members can create, and there is no sandbox, so calls hit real workspace data. missing for 10: runnable access without a paid Business/Enterprise key, a sandbox or test environment for safe experimentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
